title: Longest substring without repeating characters
summary: Find the length of the longest contiguous substring with no repeated characters.
requirements: Treat each JavaScript Unicode code point (for...of) as one character.
Return a length, not the substring.
hints: Track the most recent index of each character.
When a character was seen inside the current window, move the left edge.
Use Math.max(left, lastSeen + 1) so the left edge never moves backward.
